entries.1a494d5b131a6a2a: Under the founding philosophy 'Nurture people, make use of people', with the mission 'Create opportunities to work and hope', the company is advancing a three-year medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its first year. Toward realizing the vision of 'transforming into a corporate group with high growth potential', it intends to pursue diversification of its business portfolio, optimal allocation of personnel through reorganization of the group's organization, and strengthening of its business base through M&A and capital and business alliances in growth areas. It identifies three material issues (materiality): 'Creating workplaces that are easy to work in', 'Responding to social and structural changes', and 'Strengthening governance'.
